name: opencode-foreman
description: A config-driven, always-awake foreman loop for OpenCode: one self-contained plugin that turns a plan into a graph of units, dispatches parallel workers into git worktrees, verifies them, and publishes the finished plan.

scripts.foreman:test: node scripts/foreman/tests/guards-smoke.mjs && node scripts/foreman/tests/acceptance-smoke.mjs && node scripts/foreman/tests/multi-loop-smoke.mjs && node scripts/foreman/tests/human-steer-smoke.mjs && node scripts/foreman/tests/parallel-scale.mjs && node scripts/foreman/tests/repo-pointer-smoke.mjs && node scripts/foreman/tests/rsi-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run foreman:test
